Segment.description:
One position in a name.

Either ``tokens`` or ``pattern`` has to be given: a segment with neither would accept
anything, which is the same as not describing it at all.

pattern.description: A regular expression for a free position, e.g. the descriptive part of a name.
pattern.title: Pattern

optional.description: A trailing position that a name may leave out.
optional.title: Optional

repeatable.description: The position may be filled more than once, e.g. a multi word descriptive part.
repeatable.title: Repeatable
